name: About Time for a Splash!
source:
A college graduate was filled with fond memories of his high school years. Join him as he reconnects with his ol’ buddies via a summer vacation. 

[From [url=http://dagitabsoft.wordpress.com/visual-novels/]DagitabSoft[/url]]
translation:
一位大學畢業生滿懷對高中時光的美好回憶。與他一同度過一個暑假，重新聯絡那些老朋友吧。

（摘自[url=http://dagitabsoft.wordpress.com/visual-novels/]DagitabSoft[/url]）
